notes: Counts cover only this batch of 5 pinned domestic sources and their 10 observations; they are review-record statistics, not API totals and not the domestic corpus.
All five are new candidates with no registry binding; 'implement' disposition marks a proposed direction only — nothing here is implemented, tested, or admitted by G0/G1.
Sources remain in_review with whole_source_reviewed=false; the remaining 321 sources of batch_1_A stay required_review.
The four voice-resource calls share one path across four HTTP methods; they are registered as four distinct operations. 1277 lives on a separate alarm route with the serial in the path.

Params-only requests (no body, no extra Content-Type) are SDK design choices supported by the Codex example cross-check, not official prohibitions; moreInfo recorded as Object(table)+null(example) everywhere; no data layer fabricated.
CSEPMR511 model restriction applies to 1273 only; 111005 kept verbatim unfinished; 111011 channel error kept without inventing a channel param.
voiceUrl/voiceName required flags on 1273/1281 kept per tables; voiceUrl values treated as opaque locators — no download, upload, transcode, polling, playback, or auto-retry proposed.
All four writes (1263/1273/1277/1281) are not_authorized for live; no device operations, tests, SDK changes, or shared-file writes were performed.
